subject: Procurement readiness & next steps for BrightWave pilot
body:
Message 1 - 2026-06-15 13:10 PDT
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@brightwavehealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + procurement checklist for BrightWave pilot

Thanks again for the time today, Olivia — great conversation. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can get the pilot moving:

- Scope: 30-day pilot, internal-facing triage assistant for clinical ops (approx. 50k tokens/day peak).
- Success criteria: response accuracy on 5 canonical workflows, sub-250ms median gen latency for short prompts, and integration with your SSO for staff testers.
- Commercial path: two options we typically see — PO (net 30) for pilots transitioning to annual, or card for initial proof-of-concept to speed things up. You mentioned procurement would prefer PO if feasible.

Next steps I can action:
1) Send a vendor packet (W-9, vendor setup form, banking remit fields) for your procurement team to start vendor setup.
2) Share a short SOW + pilot onboarding checklist.
3) If helpful, schedule a 15-min call with our procurement lead to walk your vendor team through the packet.

Can you confirm: (a) who on your side handles vendor onboarding (name + procurement email), (b) whether BrightWave prefers PO vs card for a pilot, and (c) any marketplace interest (e.g., GCP/AWS marketplace) so we can share marketplace contract options?

I attached a redwood vendor packet template we can complete with your details and a rough SOW draft. If procurement wants DocuSign, we can route it that way.

Thanks — happy to keep this lightweight.

Best,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez | Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
attach: Redwood-vendor-packet.pdf, SOW-pilot-draft.docx

-----

Message 2 - 2026-06-16 09:22 PDT
From: Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@brightwavehealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@brightwavehealth.com, Jason Li <jason.li@brightwavehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + procurement checklist for BrightWave pilot

Hi Sergio — thanks for the clear recap and for sending the packet.

Quick answers:
- Vendor onboarding is handled by our procurement team (procurement@brightwavehealth.com); Jason Li is the procurement lead and I’ve cc’d him.
- Our default is PO (net 30) for pilots over $5k, but we can use a credit card for small pilots if we need to move faster. This pilot will likely be in the PO lane but Jason will confirm the threshold.
- Marketplace: we evaluate marketplace purchases for long-term procurement (esp. for cloud credits), but for pilots we typically do direct contracts. Not opposed to marketplace if it simplifies billing.

Action items from our side:
- Jason, can you confirm the vendor packet items BrightWave needs? I believe a completed W-9 (or W-8 for foreign vendors), vendor setup form, and banking remit info are standard.
- Sergio, please include any fields you need filled exactly as they appear on your form (tax ID format, payee name, remittance contact).

Olivia
Director, Clinical Ops
BrightWave Health

-----

Message 3 - 2026-06-18 11:05 PDT
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: procurement@brightwavehealth.com, Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@brightwavehealth.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor packet fields + sample completed W-9

Hi Jason / procurement team — nice to e-meet you. I’ve attached a pre-filled vendor packet to speed things up. Quick notes:

- Attachments: Redwood-vendor-packet.pdf (fillable), BrightWave-W9-requested.pdf (sample completed W-9 for reference), SOW-pilot-draft.docx.
- Payee name should be exactly: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID: 12-3456789 (please confirm format your system requires).
- Banking/remit: if you require ACH information we can provide an AML-friendly remit file; otherwise we can route through our finance portal.

If PO is preferred, we can accept the PO with net-30 terms and invoice. If you’d like to run the pilot on card to get started while PO completes, we can support that and credit the invoice if the PO is issued within 60 days. Happy to provide a short PO template if helpful.

Would you like us to send the vendor packet via DocuSign or as an email attachment? DocuSign tends to speed signatures for procurement teams.

Thanks,
Sergio
attach: Redwood-vendor-packet.pdf, BrightWave-W9-requested.pdf, SOW-pilot-draft.docx

Message 4 - 2026-06-19 15:40 PDT
From: Jason Li <jason.li@brightwavehealth.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Olivia Hart <olivia.hart@brightwavehealth.com>
Cc: procurement@brightwavehealth.com
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor packet fields + sample completed W-9

Thanks, Sergio. Confirming receipt. A few procurement notes:

- Required: completed W-9 (we’ll accept your sample once you populate the payee fields for our records), vendor setup form (we have a BrightWave template — I’ll attach our internal packet once I’m back at my desk Monday), and banking remit for ACH if you want to be paid via ACH.
- PO vs card: PO preferred for pilots > $3k in our system. For speed, we can issue a PCard for initial payment and convert to PO. Timeline: 5-10 business days once we have a completed packet and approver sign-off.
- Marketplace: Not required for pilot. If post-pilot we pursue marketplace purchase, we’ll evaluate based on compliance & billing simplicity.

Please send the vendor packet with the payee and tax ID filled in, and we’ll queue it.

Regards,
Jason Li
Procurement Lead
BrightWave Health

If you prefer, Monica (our sales ops manager) can be on a quick 10-min call with Jason to align on any format quirks for your vendor portal. Monica, can you do a quick sync this week?
